Write a Python decorator retry(max_attempts, exceptions) that retries a function up to max_attempts times if it raises one of the listed exception types. Raise the last exception if all attempts fail. Only return the code.
tasks.test_code:
from solution import retry
attempts = [0]
@retry(3, [ValueError])
def flaky():
    attempts[0] += 1
    if attempts[0] < 3:
        raise ValueError('fail')
    return 'ok'
assert flaky() == 'ok'
assert attempts[0] == 3
print('PASS')
